dedupe_keys.name: database of corroded reinforced concrete columns

description: Database of Corroded Reinforced Concrete Columns is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jiaxing Ma, Nanyang Technological University Singapore (ntu.edu.sg). Reinforced concrete (RC) columns are employed in buildings as the primary load-bearing and lateral force-resisting elements. The deterioration of the durability of reinforced concrete (RC) columns would result in insufficient seismic capacity for structures. Despite progress in the literature, the understanding of these columns is still limited due to the complexities brought by the corrosion. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-fjqm-sa92. Keywords: Corrosion; Column; Reinforced Concrete. Published 2023-10-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
